title: Software Engineer, Full-Stack (New Grad)
text:
ParcelLoop Logistics builds modern dispatch, live parcel tracking, and reverse-logistics returns software for regional courier networks and omnichannel e-commerce brands. Our web dashboards and backend APIs power thousands of dispatchers, drivers, and warehouse operators across forty metropolitan hubs every single day.

We are looking for an ambitious, collaborative full-stack Software Engineer (New Grad / Early Career) to join our Core Product Engineering squad. You will own and ship customer-facing features across our TypeScript and React web applications, build reliable low-latency backend services in Node.js and Python, and collaborate directly with product designers, product managers, and senior engineers from your very first sprint.

What You Will Do:
- Build responsive, accessible web frontends using modern TypeScript, React, and component-driven state management.
- Develop, document, and maintain RESTful and GraphQL backend APIs in Node.js and Python.
- Design normalized relational database schemas, write migrations, and optimize slow queries in PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- Rapidly prototype new product ideas and deliver working MVPs under tight deadlines in a fast-paced startup environment.
- Write automated unit, integration, and end-to-end browser test suites and maintain continuous integration pipelines.
- Communicate technical trade-offs clearly in design reviews and collaborate closely across product, design, and engineering peers.

Minimum Qualifications:
- B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative technical field (graduating by Spring/Summer 2025 or recently graduated).
- Hands-on experience shipping web applications through software engineering internships, capstone projects, or hackathons.

Nice to Have:
- Experience deploying containerized backend services using Docker to Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud Platform.
- Experience with real-time bidirectional communication using WebSockets or Server-Sent Events (SSE) for live UI updates.
- Experience instrumenting product analytics, event tracking schemas, or A/B feature experiments.
